why: Which cycle count may be printed beside which area figure, declared.
Cycles come out of Vitis cosim and area out of Design Compiler. Each flow
is internally consistent, so no single-flow gate can see the one error
this project keeps making: quoting the two beside each other when they
were taken on different RTL. check_pairing.py judges every entry here by
one rule, and this file records both what may be paired and what may not.
A refusal is not a gap in the record. It is the record.

pairings.name: T4 MAXDIM=16 baseline -- the published five, beside their own area

cycles.where: the export's own README, measured on this export

note: These are NOT the design's current published row. reproduce.sh
reproduces 175 / 265 / 421 / 482 / 674, measured at TPU_QD=16; this
export was emitted from allo 6db2dc7a on 2026-09-22, and TPU_QD did
not default to 16 until 63ee6ec7 on 2026-09-24. The current row and
this area figure are therefore NOT pairable, and that pair is refused
below. What is pairable is the row this export itself carries.

pairings.name: T8 MAXDIM=64 QD=16 -- the DC run on the export now in the tree
note: The run recorded the export under the path 'rtl_T8_qd16'; the tree calls it 'T8_MAXDIM64'. Declared as an alias rather than renamed, because the evidence that they are the same RTL is the checksum, not the path: sv2v_manifest.f in dev/records/tinytpu/rtl_handoff/T8_MAXDIM64/ is md5 f56178f6, and that is the md5 the run's settings.json records. The checker refused this pairing until the alias was declared, which is the behaviour asked for -- a name that nearly matches is not evidence.
This is what cleared the refusal below. That entry says 'what clears it:
one DC run on the current export'; this is that run, and it was committed
without being declared, which is why the pairing gate was red.
The tie is the checksum, not the name. sv2v_manifest.f in
dev/records/tinytpu/rtl_handoff/T8_MAXDIM64/ is md5 f56178f6, and this
run's settings.json records manifest_md5 f56178f6. The '_qd16' in the
variant name is not evidence of anything: QD=16 is read from the
export's own MANIFEST.json, which carries "QD": 16 as a top-level key.
That export is still the only committed TinyTPU export that records QD,
so this is the only T=8 pairing whose QD is derived rather than assumed.
Two rows are quoted for comparability with the T4 entries; the export's
MANIFEST.json carries eight shapes (8x8x8 286 through 64x64x64 6916).

note: The run recorded the export under the path 'rtl_T8_qd16'; the tree calls it 'T8_MAXDIM64'. Declared as an alias rather than renamed, because the evidence that they are the same RTL is the checksum, not the path: sv2v_manifest.f in dev/records/tinytpu/rtl_handoff/T8_MAXDIM64/ is md5 f56178f6, and that is the md5 the run's settings.json records. The checker refused this pairing until the alias was declared, which is the behaviour asked for -- a name that nearly matches is not evidence.
md5 1d92213e, which ties it to this export -- but NOT uniquely:
sv2v_manifest_nomem.f and sv2v_manifest_nomem_stubbed.f are
byte-identical, so the checksum cannot say which of the two the run
read. It is harmless here because they are the same bytes, and it is
recorded because a checksum that matches two files is weaker evidence
than one that matches one.

refused.name: the workload suite's model cycles beside the T4 MAXDIM=64 shipped area
why: This is the pair the end-to-end claim wants -- PyTorch model to cycles
to area -- and it is not admissible today.
The model cycles were measured at TPU_QD=16 on a csynth of the working
checkout. The area was synthesised from the T4_MAXDIM64_shipped
export, emitted from allo 6db2dc7a on 2026-09-22 -- two days before
63ee6ec7 made QD=16 the default -- and that export records no QD at
all. Neither its MANIFEST.json nor its README names one.
The absence is the point. QD is the depth of every point-to-point
channel, so it changes both the area and whether the program finishes
at all; QD=16 is the whole reason mlp_tiny, mlp_deep and mlp_small
have RTL numbers. Reading the missing field as 'it was probably the
default' would be inferring an association that has to be declared,
and the default at that commit was 8.
What clears it: a re-export of this variant at a recorded QD, and one
DC run on it. Both are named in the remote tier of e2e_gate.sh. Until
then the honest statement is that this repository has a verified
model-to-cycles path and a verified RTL-to-area path and no admissible
join between them.

refused.name: the design's current published row beside the MAXDIM=16 baseline area
why: 175 / 265 / 421 / 482 / 674 is a TPU_QD=16 row. This export carries
172 / 262 / 418 / 484 / 686 and records no QD, because it predates the
default moving. The +4 / +4 / +4 / -1 / -11 between them is the QD
change itself, which is the clearest possible demonstration that the
two rows are different machines.
Pairing the current row with this area is a one-line edit that nothing
else in the tree would catch, and it is wrong. The same-export pairing
above is the admissible one.

refused.name: T8 MAXDIM=64 -- area against the export now in the tree
why: Found by this checker rather than declared into it. The T8 area,
2,481,925 um2, was synthesised on 2026-09-22 from the export at
7a3c2a17, sv2v_manifest.f md5 6e9b2596. On 2026-09-24 that export was
replaced -- f0ee3223, 'tinytpu: re-export T=8, MAXDIM=64 against QD=16
main' -- and the manifest in the tree is now md5 f5617 8f6, 442 lines
against 433 files recorded by the run.
So the T8 export a reader finds is not the RTL the T8 area describes,
and the cycles the new export carries (8x8x8 286 ... 64x64x64 6916, at
the QD=16 it records) were measured on the new one. The area figure is
not wrong; it is orphaned. It is the only committed TinyTPU export
that records QD, and it is the one whose area predates the recording.
What clears it: one DC run on the current export. The area will move.

CLEARED 2026-09-25: the DC run on the current export exists and is now declared above as T8_MAXDIM64_qd16. This entry stays because the 2,481,925 um2 figure itself is still orphaned -- it describes RTL that is no longer in the tree -- and deleting it would remove the record of why that number must not be quoted.

refused.name: Gemmini DIM=8, full
refused.why: As above, and additionally this run does not close timing: -0.01 ns on 3.33, 80 violating paths. check_numbers.py holds that acknowledgement; a synthesis node reports success when synthesis COMPLETED, not when timing CLOSED.
